main.title: Project Goal and Final Baseline
main.speaker: A
main.goal: Identify the completed CPU and the frozen delivery baseline.
main.speech: Good morning. We present our sixteen-bit, five-stage CPU on EES-331. The accepted AC1 baseline connects a defined instruction set, integrated architecture, functional evidence, and physical cycle counters.
main.cue: 先说明最终版本与本次范围。这里的实板结论是五个正常程序和停止后的S1重启。

main.title: ISA Design
main.speaker: A
main.goal: Explain how instruction semantics determine datapath resources and writes.
main.speech: The instruction word has four opcode bits, two destination bits, two source bits, and eight immediate bits. All four registers, including R zero, are writable. Arithmetic register instructions read both registers. An immediate MOV needs no old register value. Loads read a base register, while stores read a base and a separate data register. Constants use zero extension. Memory displacements and conditional branches use sign extension. ADD and SUB update carry and overflow. CMP updates only Z. These rules determine the operand paths and the write permissions used by the hardware.
main.cue: 指向4+2+2+8字段，再讲真实源和标志更新。C为加法进位或减法无借位；完整编码在备用13页。

main.title: From ISA to a Verified CPU
main.speaker: A
main.goal: Explain design dependencies and the actual iterative course workflow.
main.speech: We first fixed observable instruction behavior and the board constraints. Next, we assigned operations to resources and defined the memory timing. We then specified the four pipeline boundaries, including data, control intentions, and valid tags. Decode, forwarding, interlock, cancellation, and stopping rules followed from those contracts. Finally, we connected the system and checked it through simulation, implementation, and board observation. The course development was iterative: basic modules came first, followed by datapath integration and control. We revised the interfaces as the design matured. I will now hand over to B to explain how these decisions form the integrated system.
main.cue: 强调这是设计依赖顺序，实际课程按Pre2模块、Pre3模块/ISA、Pre4数据通路、Pre5控制迭代推进。

main.title: System Integration and Interfaces
main.speaker: B
main.goal: Distinguish core ports, system memory, and physical board interfaces.
main.speech: The execution core connects to separate instruction and data memories. Each memory contains two hundred and fifty-six sixteen-bit words and uses synchronous reads. The core supplies sixteen-bit word addresses. It checks the complete data address before selecting a physical memory entry. The original execution interface carries clock, reset, memory addresses, data, enables, and stopped status. At board level, the design adds the clock buffer, synchronized reset request, performance counters, and VIO. VIO reads a register writeback shadow, flags, and stopping information. Its reset output is an active control input. These observation resources do not supply operands to the CPU.
main.cue: 区分core逻辑端口与板级引脚。寄存器读数来自写回影子，不能称为独立读回物理RF或全部DM。

main.title: Five-Stage Datapath
main.speaker: B
main.goal: Trace values through resources and the existing four stage boundaries.
main.speech: The PC supplies the fetch address. Decode reads the register file and extends the immediate. In execute, forwarding selects the newest available operands before the ALU inputs are selected. A store uses Rs for its base address and Rd for its data, so these are separate paths. Memory performs a qualified load or store. Writeback selects an execution result or returned load data and updates the architectural state. A successful store writes memory once, then retains a valid completion tag in writeback. The synchronous instruction output supplies the decode data boundary, and the data-memory output supplies the load boundary. Data and control remain aligned. C will now explain how the controller coordinates these stages.
main.cue: 依次沿五级指图。重点讲STR两条源路径、MEM唯一写入、WB保留标签；IM/DM输出处不再串接IR/MDR。

main.title: How Pipeline Control Works
main.speaker: C
main.goal: Relate global modes, cross-stage arbitration and local qualified actions.
main.speech: Our controller has three levels of responsibility. The global mode handles running, draining, and final stopping. During RUN, all five stages can process different instructions. Cross-stage logic compares register dependencies and resolves events by instruction age. Stage-local logic turns the current instruction's control intentions into actual actions. For example, decode can request a register write, but only a valid, fault-free writeback slot can enable that write. Control fields travel beside the instruction's data and tags. A cancelled slot cannot update memory, registers, or flags, even if its old control bits remain. The five operating modes describe the whole processor. They do not form a serial fetch-to-writeback controller. The next example shows why coordination must observe more than one stage.
main.cue: 先讲三层职责，再指CW到rf_we的资格关系。五个局部CU是逻辑职责，不是五个独立FSM或新增实体模块。

main.title: Data Dependencies and Interlock
main.speaker: C
main.goal: Explain the exact load-use hold and store path using the eight-cycle trace.
main.speech: This simulation loads seven into R zero and immediately stores it through another base register. In cycle three, the load is in execute and the store is in decode. The store needs the load result, which is not ready. The interlock holds the PC and decode state and inserts a bubble into execute. Older instructions continue. At the end of cycle four, synchronous memory returns the load data. In cycle five, the store enters execute and receives seven from writeback forwarding. The store writes memory in cycle six. Its valid tag continues through writeback in cycle seven, and HALT completes in cycle eight. The load's address must never be forwarded as its data. Adjacent ADD instructions can instead forward a ready memory-stage result without this stall. D will next explain control transfers and verification.
main.cue: 按C3保持/C4 bubble/C5 W→EX/C6写DM/C7 STR有效WB/C8 HALT指图。初始RF/DM由该仿真TB预置，不声称是板上演示。

main.title: Branch Redirect and Safe Completion
main.speaker: D
main.goal: Explain flag forwarding, wrong-path cancellation, and the WB halt edge.
main.speech: CMP produces an equality candidate, and JZ uses it in execute before architectural Z writeback. In cycle four, the branch redirects and cancels the younger store. The branch itself continues through memory and writeback. The target HALT reaches its stopping edge in cycle nine, allowing older work to finish. Valid tags distinguish instructions from bubbles and cancelled slots. This simulation checks the accepted redirect and the absence of a wrong-path memory write. These events form part of our functional verification.
main.cue: 指C4的M.CMP与X.JZ，说明M→Z选择；错误STR不得写DM；HALT的正式停止边沿在C9的WB。

main.title: Functional Verification Strategy
main.speaker: D
main.goal: Connect independent expectations, edge checks and real trace evidence.
main.speech: Reference behavior comes from the ISA and independently prepared test conditions. The testbench compares writes, flags, stopping behavior, and clock-by-clock events such as front-end hold and an execute bubble. The external-ISA archive contains forty-eight cases and ten reset witnesses. The highlighted load-store trace checks one stall and one memory write, as well as the final result. These internal timing observations come from simulation. The next page separately checks final state and cycle counters on the implemented board system.
main.cue: 把输入、ISA参考、DUT和自动比较串起来。48案例+10复位见证不等于全CPU穷举；工具检查也不等于板上功能测试。

main.title: EES-331 Board Results
main.speaker: D
main.goal: Present decoded physical evidence with correct observation scope.
main.speech: All five archived board programs reached their expected normal stop. For each program, we decoded two VIO snapshots and checked the writeback shadow, architectural flags, stop PC, last store, and counters. The checksum program ends with R one equal to hexadecimal one two three two after fifty-five cycles. In the physical S one test, the CPU had already stopped. Holding the button cleared the public running state and counters. Releasing it restarted the program, which again completed in fifty-five cycles. These tables decode the archived VIO data. E will now use those counters to explain performance.
main.cue: 明确标注Decoded archived VIO snapshots。指五程序摘要、R1=0x1232、S1 pressed计数0与after计数55。

main.title: Explaining CPU Performance
main.speaker: E
main.goal: Explain useful instruction work and the measured sources of extra cycles.
main.speech: The chart separates useful instruction count from pipeline overhead. For these five normal HALT programs, total cycles equal N plus four, plus S, plus twice R. N includes HALT. Four accounts for pipeline filling and completion, S counts load-use stalls, and each accepted redirect costs two cycles. For baseline, ten instructions plus four, one stall, and two redirect cycles gives seventeen. For loop, four redirects contribute eight extra cycles. For checksum, thirty-five instructions plus four and sixteen stalls gives fifty-five. This explains its dominant overhead. CPI divides cycles by completed instructions, so it also reflects instruction mix and fixed overhead. Checksum has more stalls than baseline, but its CPI is about one point five seven, compared with one point seven zero. It also completes more instructions, spreading the four-cycle fixed overhead across a larger instruction count. The chart therefore supports an explanation of each workload. A design speedup would require comparing the same program under matched conditions. Different programs perform different work, and total cycles alone do not rank their designs. The counters came from board VIO. Times derived using ten nanoseconds per cycle assume the target hundred-megahertz clock. We did not independently measure frequency or wall time. Existing routed reports separately show that all five designs meet their setup and hold checks. Detailed resource results and the isolated optimization comparison are available in the backup slides.
main.cue: 先解释图中N、固定4、S、2R四段。带入baseline和checksum；CPI有固定开销，不能用不同工作量总周期直接排名。时间只作设计频率推算。

main.title: What We Delivered
main.speaker: E
main.goal: Close against the four course requirements and the accepted baseline.
main.speech: We delivered the ISA, integrated architecture, design process, and verification evidence. Simulation checks internal execution. EES-331 confirms the selected programs and reset restart. Counters explain performance overhead. Default AC1 is our accepted baseline. Thank you.
main.cue: 对应老师四项要求结束。答辩再跳转备用页，不在结尾开启新的架构介绍。

backup.title: ISA Encoding Reference
backup.goal: Provide the complete ISA v1.5 opcode map.
backup.answer: The opcode occupies bits fifteen through twelve. The low register and immediate fields have meanings defined by each instruction form. AND and OR use opcodes two and three. LDR and STR use eight and nine. B and F are reserved. Current ISA v1.5 is the encoding authority.
backup.cue: 完整16种Opcode。历史Pre4机器码要按迁移表解释。

backup.title: Interface Reference
backup.goal: Separate execution, observation and board interfaces.
backup.answer: These twelve original core execution ports total eighty-seven bits. They connect to the system memories, rather than directly to board pins. Diagnostic observation outputs are additional. The board top has clock, button and eight LED ports. JTAG reaches VIO through the FPGA debug infrastructure.
backup.cue: 87位只计原执行接口；额外观测端口另列，板级逻辑IO为10个。

backup.title: Operating Modes and Event Priority
backup.goal: Explain the global state machine and event ordering.
backup.answer: RUN allows normal progress, stalls and accepted redirects. HALT and faults start drain modes. The stopping token must reach writeback before the corresponding final state. Reset has highest priority. An older memory fault suppresses a younger execute event while preserving eligible older writeback. Only reset leaves the final stopped modes.
backup.cue: 状态：RUN、DRAIN_HALT、DRAIN_FAULT、HALTED、FAULTED。仲裁优先级按年龄与资格，不把互斥事件当作必然同拍。

backup.title: Additional Hazard Cases
backup.goal: Support questions on source roles, newest producers and fault age.
backup.answer: Forwarding chooses the nearest eligible producer. A matching memory-stage load blocks an older same-register writeback value until data is ready. Register zero participates normally. Immediate MOV has no register source, preventing a false dependency. A store needs separate base and data checks. The fault and HALT examples here come from simulation.
backup.cue: 相邻load真实源停1拍，普通ALU可M前递；假相关、R0和Rd=Rs要识别真实use掩码。

backup.title: Reference Model and Coverage
backup.goal: Explain why the automated checks are meaningful and bounded.
backup.answer: The external ISA model predicts instruction effects, while the testbench checks actual writes and timing events. Directed boundaries and manual examples cross-check the reference calculations. Forty-eight cases and ten reset witnesses are a bounded program set. The twenty-one archived host and document checks validate the evidence pipeline, not twenty-one physical CPU scenarios.
backup.cue: 回答自己算自己验证：独立ISA行为、人工边界例、逐边沿检查、负向错误注入分别说明。

backup.title: Raw VIO and Physical Reset Evidence
backup.goal: Connect decoded values to the captured words and real button observations.
backup.answer: The raw state probe contains the build identity, register writeback shadow, flags and stop information. The performance probe contains five thirty-two-bit counters. The S one observer first confirmed that VIO reset was released and then read the physical button response. Heartbeat and build identity remain independent of CPU reset. These captures do not independently dump every physical register or data-memory word.
backup.cue: 四帧before/pressed/after_0/after_1，按住时RF影子和计数0，释放后两帧55周期结果相同；心跳可不同。

backup.title: FPGA Resources and Routed Timing
backup.goal: Show the correct implementation scope for resource and timing values.
backup.answer: These values belong to the complete board top, including VIO, memory and observation logic. They are not core-only resource counts. Each selected program uses two BRAM18 blocks. Setup and hold slack are positive for all five archived routed implementations. Static timing and finite board execution are complementary evidence, rather than an independent measurement of maximum clock frequency.
backup.cue: Total LUT包含LUTRAM，不能把LUT原语个数当物理总LUT；不将OOC和含VIO整机面积直接比较。

backup.title: Isolated WB-to-MEM Optimization
backup.goal: Explain the optional candidate and its implementation tradeoff.
backup.answer: The candidate delays store data consumption until memory and can forward ready writeback data there. Store base addresses still need execute-stage operands. Offline tests and routed comparisons reduce memory-copy cycles from fifteen to fourteen and checksum cycles from fifty-five to forty-seven. The checksum build adds eighty-six LUTs and two flip-flops. This candidate has not received the default AC1 physical board acceptance.
backup.cue: 两项候选互相隔离；本页为离线结果。55/47约1.17倍固定频率加速，不宣称已上板。

questions: Why do five pipeline stages not mean five global execution states?
RUN can persist while different instructions occupy all five stages. The global modes describe running, draining and stopping. Local actions depend on each slot and cross-stage decisions.
What is the difference between a control intention and an enable?
Decode creates an intention such as reg_write. Validity, fault status, reset and mode qualify it at the action stage. rf_we is the resulting writeback enable.
Why does load-to-store need a stall in default AC1?

Both store operands are prepared in EX. An adjacent load returns data only at the end of MEM. The store waits one cycle, then forwards ready W data into EX. The WB-to-MEM candidate uses a different contract.
Why does output reg not necessarily imply flip-flops?

A fully assigned combinational always block describes combinational logic. The Verilog variable type permits procedural assignment. State requires clocked storage or incomplete combinational assignment.
What do carry and overflow mean?
For ADD, C is the unsigned carry out. For SUB, C means no borrow. V detects signed overflow. ADD and SUB update C/V, CMP updates Z, and memory-address arithmetic preserves architectural flags.
Where do LDR, STR and CMP calculate their results?
LDR and STR use the ALU for base plus signed displacement, preserving flags. CMP uses the independent equality path on forwarded operands and writes Z in WB.
Why does CMP-to-JZ need no register data stall?
JZ selects the newest eligible CMP Z candidate from M, then W, then saved Z. CMP still updates architectural Z at WB. The branch uses the candidate as a condition.
How does synchronous memory avoid adding a sixth stage?

The registered IM output is the ID instruction data boundary. The registered DM output supplies the WB load value. The existing tag registers align with those outputs. No extra IR or MDR is cascaded there.
How independent is the reference model?

It implements ISA effects separately from pipeline control and is cross-checked against explicit boundary vectors. Timing assertions check implementation-specific events separately. Shared specification errors remain possible, so finite passing tests are not a full proof.
What exactly did the board verify?

Five normal-HALT programs, each with two stable VIO snapshots, plus physical S1 reset/restart after stopping. RF observations are writeback shadows. Fault paths and internal cycle traces retain their simulation evidence.
Why can a longer program have a lower CPI?
Fixed filling overhead is amortized across more completed instructions, and instruction mixes incur different stalls and redirects. Compare the work and overhead, not total cycles alone.
Is the CPU execution time directly measured?
Cycle counters are physically observed. Converting them to nanoseconds assumes the designed 100 MHz clock. Independent frequency, wall-time and power measurements were not performed.
